properties.name: agent.base-url
properties.description: Private address of agent-service, which keeps the chat. Only this service talks to it. Set with AGENT_BASE_URL.

properties.name: sms.username
properties.description: Africa's Talking username. Use sandbox with the sandbox address. Only used when agentx.code-delivery is sms. Set with SMS_USERNAME.

properties.name: sms.api-key
properties.description: Africa's Talking API key. Only used when agentx.code-delivery is sms. Set with SMS_API_KEY.

properties.name: sms.sender-id
properties.description: Sender name shown on the sign-in SMS. Leave blank to use the account default. Set with SMS_SENDER_ID.

properties.name: sms.base-url
properties.description: Africa's Talking address. The sandbox address does not reach real phones. Use https://api.africastalking.com with a live key. Set with SMS_BASE_URL.

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma separated browser origins allowed to call this service, for the test console (http://localhost:8000) and the app in Chrome (http://localhost:3000). Empty means off. Never set this in production. Set with CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

properties.name: internal.key
properties.description: Shared secret between our own services, sent in the X-Internal-Key header. Only agent-service calls /internal/**. Set with INTERNAL_KEY.

properties.name: agentx.env
properties.description: Which copy of the system this is: development, staging (uat means the same) or production. production refuses to start with development only settings; staging only warns. Outside production, production Daraja is refused and email subjects get a [DEV] or [STAGING] tag. Set with APP_ENV.

properties.name: agentx.allow-live-daraja
properties.description: Lets a copy that is not production call Safaricom's production Daraja. Leave false unless you really mean it. Set with AGENTX_ALLOW_LIVE_DARAJA.

properties.name: agentx.token-secret
properties.description: Signs the phone app's login tokens and hashes link codes. At least 32 random characters. Set with AGENTX_TOKEN_SECRET.

properties.name: agentx.token-ttl
properties.description: How long a phone app login token stays valid. Set with AGENTX_TOKEN_TTL.

properties.name: agentx.link-code-ttl
properties.description: How long a sign-in code can be used after it is issued.

properties.name: agentx.link-max-attempts
properties.description: Wrong guesses allowed on one sign-in code before it stops working.

properties.name: agentx.link-codes-per-hour
properties.description: How many sign-in codes one phone number can ask for per hour. Set with AGENTX_CODES_PER_HOUR.

properties.name: agentx.action-ttl
properties.description: How long a wallet request waits for the customer before it expires. Set with AGENTX_ACTION_TTL.

properties.name: agentx.max-open-actions
properties.description: Most wallet requests one customer can have open at the same time.

properties.name: agentx.max-amount
properties.description: Largest amount in KES a request may carry. M-Pesa's own limits still apply on the phone; this only stops obviously wrong requests. Set with AGENTX_MAX_AMOUNT.

properties.name: agentx.min-airtime
properties.description: Smallest airtime purchase in KES.

properties.name: agentx.initiator.result-url
properties.description: Where Safaricom posts the final result of B2C, B2B, Pochi, balance, status and reversal requests. An address, or a template with {id} and {token}. Blank uses agentx.public-base-url. Set with AGENTX_RESULT_URL.

properties.name: agentx.initiator.timeout-url
properties.description: Where Safaricom posts the notice that such a request waited too long in its queue. An address, or a template with {id} and {token}. Blank uses agentx.public-base-url. Set with AGENTX_TIMEOUT_URL.

properties.name: agentx.public-base-url
properties.description: Public HTTPS address of this service. Links shown in the chat look like PUBLIC_BASE_URL/a/ACTION_ID. Set with AGENTX_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

properties.name: agentx.android-package
properties.description: Android package name for app links that open the app directly. Leave blank until the app is published. Set with AGENTX_ANDROID_PACKAGE.

properties.name: agentx.android-sha256
properties.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the Android signing certificate, for app links. Leave blank until the app is published. Set with AGENTX_ANDROID_SHA256.

properties.name: agentx.ios-app-id
properties.description: iOS app id (team id plus bundle id) for app links. Leave blank until the app is published. Set with AGENTX_IOS_APP_ID.

properties.name: agentx.code-delivery
properties.description: How sign-in codes are delivered. log writes the code to this service's log, for a developer. sms sends it through Africa's Talking, see the sms block. dev is the old name for log with the code shown in the app (see agentx.show-code-in-app). Set with CODE_DELIVERY.

properties.name: agentx.show-code-in-app
properties.description: Whether the app also shows the sign-in code on its own screen, so a tester needs no text message. auto shows it in development and staging and never in production. true is the same, and production refuses to start. false never shows it: use it once agentx.code-delivery is sms. With sms and the code shown, a failed text does not block signing in, because the code is on screen. Anyone who knows a phone number could sign in as it while a code is shown. A code that is shown in the app is not written to the log. Set with CODE_SHOW_IN_APP.

properties.name: agentx.app-name
properties.description: Name shown in the sign-in SMS. Set with AGENTX_APP_NAME.

properties.name: agentx.hand-off.ussd-main
properties.description: USSD code that opens the main M-Pesa menu. Verify with the M-Pesa team before relying on it. Set with HANDOFF_USSD_MAIN.

properties.name: agentx.hand-off.mpesa-android-package
properties.description: Android package name of the M-Pesa app the phone app opens. Leave blank to fall back to guided steps. Set with HANDOFF_MPESA_ANDROID_PACKAGE.

properties.name: agentx.hand-off.mpesa-ios-url
properties.description: URL that opens the M-Pesa app on iOS. Leave blank to fall back to guided steps. Set with HANDOFF_MPESA_IOS_URL.

properties.name: agentx.hand-off.ussd-templates
properties.description: USSD string per request type, with the placeholders {amount} {phone} {paybill} {account} {till}. Verify each with the M-Pesa team. The app falls back to guided steps when a template is empty. Keys are SEND_MONEY, PAY_BILL, PAY_TILL and BUY_AIRTIME.

properties.name: agentx.business.reconcile.enabled
properties.description: Runs the job that recovers STK Pushes whose callback from Safaricom never arrived. Set with AGENTX_RECONCILE_ENABLED.

properties.name: agentx.business.reconcile.interval
properties.description: How often that job runs. Set with AGENTX_RECONCILE_INTERVAL.

properties.name: agentx.business.reconcile.min-age
properties.description: How long an STK Push waits for Safaricom's callback before Safaricom is asked directly. Set with AGENTX_RECONCILE_MIN_AGE.

properties.name: agentx.business.reconcile.give-up-after
properties.description: After this long without an answer an STK Push is marked UNKNOWN, so the owner checks the M-Pesa statement. Set with AGENTX_RECONCILE_GIVE_UP_AFTER.

properties.name: agentx.brand.support-email
properties.description: Where customers write for help, shown in the email footer. Blank uses MAIL_REPLY_TO, then MAIL_FROM. Set with AGENTX_SUPPORT_EMAIL.

properties.name: agentx.brand.website
properties.description: Public address of the product. Shown as a link in the email footer and on the welcome email's button. Set with AGENTX_WEBSITE.

properties.name: agentx.brand.app-url
properties.description: Where the Open button in the emails goes: a Google Play or App Store link, or a web address that opens the app. Must start with https://. Blank uses the website. With neither set, the emails have no button. Set with AGENTX_APP_URL.

properties.name: agentx.brand.tagline
properties.description: The line under the name in the email header. Set with AGENTX_TAGLINE.
properties.defaultValue: M-Pesa payments and reports, by chat

properties.name: agentx.brand.company
properties.description: Name used in the copyright line of the emails, for example Acme Payments Ltd. Blank uses agentx.app-name. Set with AGENTX_COMPANY.

properties.name: agentx.brand.address
properties.description: Postal or street address shown in the email footer. Blank leaves it out. Set with AGENTX_COMPANY_ADDRESS.

properties.name: agentx.brand.mark
properties.description: The two or three letters in the square logo of the emails. Blank uses the initials of agentx.app-name. Set with AGENTX_BRAND_MARK.

properties.name: agentx.brand.templates-dir
properties.description: A folder with edited copies of the email files, so the look can change without a rebuild. Blank uses the built in files. Set with MAIL_TEMPLATES_DIR.

properties.name: agentx.vault.key
properties.description: Locks the business credentials people save in the app (consumer secrets, initiator passwords, passkeys). 32 random bytes in Base64, made with openssl rand -base64 32. Keep a copy somewhere safe: if this key is lost or changed, saved credentials cannot be opened and people must enter them again. Blank turns saving business credentials off. Set with AGENTX_VAULT_KEY.

properties.name: agentx.storage.type
properties.description: Where files are kept: profile pictures, and chat files when agent-service uses CHAT_MEDIA_STORE=agentx. local is a folder on this server, network is a mounted shared folder, database is the database this service already uses (no disk needed), cloudinary is Cloudinary as private files. Set with STORAGE_TYPE.

properties.name: agentx.storage.local.path
properties.description: Folder used when the type is local. Created when missing. Set with STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH.

properties.name: agentx.storage.network.path
properties.description: Where the shared folder is mounted, for example /mnt/agentx. It must already exist. Used when the type is network. Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_PATH.

properties.name: agentx.storage.network.create-if-missing
properties.description: Create the mount folder when it is not there. Leave false so a share that failed to mount is noticed instead of replaced by an empty local folder. Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_CREATE.

properties.name: agentx.storage.network.subfolder
properties.description: A folder inside the share, so several services can use one share. Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_SUBFOLDER.

properties.name: agentx.storage.database.max-file-bytes
properties.description: Biggest file kept in the database, in bytes. Bigger files are refused with a clear message. MongoDB documents stop at 16 MB, so stay below that. Used when the type is database. Set with STORAGE_DB_MAX_FILE_BYTES.

properties.name: agentx.storage.cloudinary.url
properties.description: The address shown in the Cloudinary dashboard, cloudinary://API_KEY:API_SECRET@CLOUD_NAME. When it is set, cloud-name, api-key and api-secret are not needed. Used when the type is cloudinary. Set with CLOUDINARY_URL.

properties.name: agentx.storage.cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: The Cloudinary cloud name. Set with STORAGE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME.

properties.name: agentx.storage.cloudinary.api-key
properties.description: The Cloudinary API key. Set with STORAGE_CLOUDINARY_API_KEY.

properties.name: agentx.storage.cloudinary.api-secret
properties.description: The Cloudinary API secret. Keep it out of the repository. Set with STORAGE_CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET.

properties.name: agentx.storage.cloudinary.folder
properties.description: A folder in the cloud, so one account can serve several apps. Files are uploaded as private (authenticated) raw files. Set with STORAGE_CLOUDINARY_FOLDER.

properties.name: agentx.storage.purge-interval
properties.description: How often files in the database that are past their keep time (chat files) are removed. Set with STORAGE_PURGE_INTERVAL.

properties.name: agentx.storage.max-picture-bytes
properties.description: Biggest profile picture accepted, in bytes, before it is shrunk. Set with STORAGE_MAX_PICTURE_BYTES.

values.description: Your own machine. Nothing is checked.
The shared test copy (uat is the same). Warns about settings production would refuse.
The live system. Refuses to start with development only settings.
Write the code to this service's log. For a developer.
Send the code by SMS through Africa's Talking.
The old name for log with the code shown in the app. Use agentx.show-code-in-app instead.
Shown in the app in development and staging, never in production. The default.
The same as auto, and production refuses to start.
Never shown. Use this once codes are sent by SMS.
A shared folder mounted on this server: NFS, SMB or CIFS, a NAS.
